info.desc: This Year's Model is Elvis Costello's second album and his first with The Attractions, released in 1978 (see 1978 in music). It was recorded mainly at Eden Studios in West London. It was voted the best album of the year in The Village Voice Pazz & Jop critics poll. In 2000, Q magazine placed This Year's Model at number 82 in its list of the 100 Greatest British Albums Ever. In 1987, Rolling Stone magazine ranked it number 11 on its list of the best albums of the period 1967-1987. In 2003, the album was ranked number 98 on Rolling .

podcast.body: This album is cited as an example of the first wave of British New Wave music from around 1977-78. His music during this period was not punk, nor straight rock or traditional pop, instead characterized as spiky, angular, and somewhat agitated. "Elvis Costello from a second album, 1978's This Year's Model."

podcast.body: This was Elvis Costello's second album, originally released in 1978. The album has been reissued multiple times in various formats, including cassettes, original vinyl, CD, a Reiko Remaster, and a Deluxe Edition. The latter two versions included "extra bonus material that was designed to entice as long-term fans to buy the album yet again." "This came out in 1978."
